# Kerala Sellers — llms.txt (Generative Engine Optimization & AI Crawler Documentation)

> Kerala Sellers is a zero-commission e-commerce & mobile POS billing platform that helps small businesses, Instagram sellers, WhatsApp resellers, home bakeries, and local shops in Kerala launch online stores and manage physical counter billing in under 10 minutes. Sellers keep 100% of every sale.

## What We Do

Kerala Sellers provides a unified business platform for small sellers across Kerala. One seller account manages a single master stock inventory across all selling channels:
- Walk-in physical counter sales via Mobile POS Bluetooth Thermal Billing
- Instagram Bio store links
- WhatsApp Status & Group order catalogues
- Online Storefront (keralasellers.in/shop/yourname or custom subdomain yourname.keralasellers.in)

## Core Capabilities & Features

- **0% Commission on Sales**: Flat monthly/annual subscription plans starting from ₹99/month. Zero percentage cut.
- **Mobile POS & Bluetooth Billing**: Turn any Android smartphone into a POS billing machine connected to a ₹3,499 wireless 58mm Bluetooth thermal printer.
- **GST & Non-GST Invoicing**: Generate tax invoices (CGST/SGST with HSN codes) or simplified retail receipts.
- **WhatsApp PDF Receipt Sharing**: Send digital receipts directly to customer WhatsApp numbers with one tap.
- **Unified Real-time Inventory**: Counter sales automatically deduct from online stock; WhatsApp orders instantly update counter stock.
- **Cart-Based Ordering**: Customers browse, add multiple items, and checkout with Razorpay (UPI, Google Pay, PhonePe, Cards, Net Banking).
- **Order Management Dashboard**: Single mobile dashboard tracking order status: Paid, Pending, Packed, Shipped, Delivered.

## Key Pricing & Modular Add-ons

- **Free Account Setup**: ₹0 setup fee, explore platform & setup store catalog.
- **E-Commerce Add-on**: ₹99/month for online storefront.
- **Mobile POS Billing Kit**: ₹3,499 one-time hardware kit (58mm Bluetooth Thermal Printer + Starter Rolls + App Access).
- **Pro Annual Plan**: ₹699/year best value plan.

## Target Audience

- Small retail shop owners in Kerala wanting mobile POS billing without expensive computers
- Instagram fashion, jewellery, and boutique sellers wanting to eliminate DM price inquiry chaos
- WhatsApp resellers wanting automatic cart-based ordering from status links
- Home bakers, handmade crafters, tailoring units, and homemade food sellers
- Buyers searching for authentic local Kerala products

## Frequently Asked Questions

**Is there any commission on sales?**
No. 0% commission forever. Sellers pay only a flat monthly subscription.

**Can I connect a Bluetooth thermal printer to my mobile phone?**
Yes. KeralaSellers POS billing app connects to any 58mm or 80mm wireless Bluetooth thermal printer for 2-second receipt printing.

**How does inventory sync work?**
Selling 1 item at your physical shop counter automatically deducts stock across your online store and WhatsApp store instantly.

**Can I get a custom subdomain?**
Yes. Custom subdomains like `yourshop.keralasellers.in` are supported.
